verdict.rationale: Base44 docs mention GitHub sync enabling 'version control, local development, and collaboration' on the same app, and a community vulnerability report confirms the platform has an editor/collaborator role for apps (though it was exploitable). There's no first-party documentation describing team invites, permissions, or a shared multi-user workspace experience beyond these fragments. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on team/workspace invites, role-based permissions, and hands-on evidence of multiple founders collaborating smoothly in the same project.
